object.attr: Median smoothing reduces GPS altitude noise, and a made-up elevation would mislead the receiving service. Near the ends of the route the window is shorter, and only readings that exist count; with an even number of readings the higher middle value is used. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: When the user exports a workout, the app shall write the median altitude of up to 7 track points centred on each track point, omitting the altitude without readings.
